answer_4.quote: Evaluating creativity via human judgment is costly, time-consuming, and can be unreliable with non-experts. This was demonstrated by , who found that crowdsourced judges inverted the ground-truth quality of a 90-poem dataset, ranking professionally published poems lowest and amateur poems highest.
answer_4.guideline: The benchmark for our study is the non-expert human evaluation conducted by . Their findings revealed a striking inversion of the ground truth: non-expert judges consistently rated poems from the "Good" category as the lowest quality and those from the "Bad" category as the highest.
